provenance: Fixture data is invented and labeled illustrative; a measured source keeps the SOURCE REVIEW REQUIRED line. The provenance line is drawn inside the graphic.
licenses: Project MIT for the component; pinned Lucide 0.468.0 (ISC) icons and ECharts 6.0.0 (Apache-2.0) via the existing vendor manifest; no new third-party files.

checks: token-only colors and verified palette switch
no ellipsis, collision, occlusion or clipping

purpose: Points in an illustrative 2D embedding space with the k nearest neighbors to a query.
use_when: Explain retrieval by similarity or clustering of items.
not_when: Real embedding coordinates (a projection would need a source); more than four groups or 24 points.

parameters.points: 4-24 of {label <= 12 (may be empty), x, y in 0-1, group index}

limits: Neighbors are computed from the fixture coordinates only. Labeled points must be spaced; the QA collision check rejects overlaps.
